summary: Add a maxUnit option to pretty-bytes so output can be capped at a chosen unit (2e12 with maxUnit 'GB' gives 2000 GB). Invalid units throw a TypeError. Includes readme, types and tests.
narrative: The owner asked for a maxUnit option on pretty-bytes. It should follow the unit names of the bits/binary system in use and throw a TypeError for a unit outside that system. They also asked for readme, types and tests. The conversation has one ask and no recorded observations, only seconds of activity after the ask. Memory has no evidence of work, a PR or a release.

milestones.text: Owner asked for a maxUnit option on pretty-bytes, with readme, types and tests.
